q2_gaps: focus particle over a non-eventive predication — (<Op> <filler> <event>) is defined only with an event witness, but a bare-kind relational generic is an opaque atom with no event to tag, so the parse had to nest the whole atom in the event slot

inter-clause connective whose endpoints are relational generics — the rule requires reifying both clauses as eventualities, which the kind-relation form never produces, so the connective's arguments had to be the atoms themselves

contrastive/adversative "while" (= whereas) — "while" is listed among the temporal connectives that get NO connective atom, yet the general rule licenses an atom whenever the connective states contrast; the instruction set does not separate the two senses

multi-word / phrasal verb as a kind-relation head ("take into account" -> TakeIntoAccount) — CamelCase-joining is specified for connectives, and phrasal verbs are otherwise a lowercase verb_particle event class
notes: Both clauses have bare kind NPs on each side, so the kind-level relational-generic route and its 0.9/0.9 strength are correct, and the passive was inverted to the active argument order as required. The "only" focus sits on the correct constituent and no exclusion rule was emitted.
